name: ts-monorepo
description: Template for setting up a TypeScript monorepo

scripts.test: pnpm run fmt && pnpm run -r test
scripts.lint: pnpm run fmt && npx eslint --ext js,ts,tsx .
scripts.fix: pnpm run fmt && npx eslint --fix --ext js,ts,tsx .
scripts.publish:check: pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/utils run build && pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/utils pack --dry-run && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=12288 pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/psy-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/psy-sdk pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter contract-sdk run build && pnpm --filter contract-sdk pack --dry-run
scripts.publish:all: pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/utils publish --access public --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=12288 pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/psy-sdk publish --access public --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ && pnpm --filter contract-sdk publish --access public --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
